one_liner: Gladly has a broad REST API with per-user API tokens (HTTP Basic), but access requires a Gladly customer account obtained via demo/sales; no self-serve signup or trial.
auth_notes: API token generated in Gladly settings by a user with API User role; used as the password with the user's email as the Basic username. Tokens are tied to a user and environment (sandbox vs production). Lookup Adaptor uses HMAC-SHA256 request signing, but that is for Gladly calling the developer's service, not the main API.
access_notes: No free tier or self-serve trial is documented. Gladly typically requires a demo and custom pricing, and sandbox access requires contacting Gladly. Tokens are created inside a customer's Gladly instance, which is sold via sales.
blocker_notes: A builder needs a Gladly instance (demo/sales conversation) to get a sandbox or API token. There is no self-serve path.

evidence.quote: Select **Basic** as the Authorization Type. Enter your username (your Gladly login email) and Password (the Gladly API token you just generated).
You must create an API token to access Gladly API resources (see above).
Gladly typically requires a demo and custom pricing. Request a demo and trial access at [https://www.gladly.com/request-demo]
Contact Gladly for sandbox or trial environment access.
API tokens are tied to a single user account and a particular environment.
Resources follow REST semantics and utilize industry-standard HTTP verbs, response codes, and authentication schemes. In addition, all responses and payloads are in JSON
